approach: Fix the guard where it classifies attempts. In `attempt_of` (scope_guard.rs), a job closed `failed` with a reason starting `environment:` (today only `disk::LOW_DISK`) becomes a new `Verdict::Environment`, not `Failed`. Each attempt also gets `resumed: bool`: its retry target is a `disk::resumable_stop` job and the job ran no producer. T1, T2 and T5 ignore Environment attempts. T4 counts only `Rejected`, so a failed verification still counts. T3 drops the spend of an Environment attempt whose work is kept (it is last, or the next attempt resumed it). When the last attempt resumed, T3 scales the p90 forecast to the stages left, using fixed share constants marked as estimates. All of it sits in the pure signal functions and one shared `t3_basis` helper, so `evaluate_before_attempt` and the watcher's mark numbers agree. Thresholds, athena.toml, athena-data and run/mod.rs stay unchanged. Add unit tests (with an end-to-end low-disk test if the rig reproduces the stop) and a CHANGELOG entry under Unreleased.

decisions.choice: Add `Verdict::Environment` and `AttemptRecord.resumed: bool`; add no fields to athena-data and parse no prose beyond the existing `environment:` reason prefix.
decisions.reason: The recorded outcome (state plus reason) already identifies the stop, and `disk::resumable_stop` already defines which stopped jobs a retry resumes. A variant keeps `done`, `t4_match` and the existing tests unchanged, since they match on Accepted and Rejected only.

rejected.option: A bool `environment` field on AttemptRecord next to `Verdict::Failed`
rejected.why: A variant makes the case explicit in every match and leaves the existing `att(Verdict::Failed, ...)` tests alone.

rejected.option: A new record kind or outcome field in athena-data
rejected.why: Out of scope; the reading says no new record fields.

decisions.choice: Detect a resuming job from records: its retry target passes `crate::disk::resumable_stop(state, reason)` and the job has no `Role::Producer` invocation.
decisions.reason: The resume mark in the state directory is deleted when the resuming job closes (`settle_resume_marks`), so the watcher cannot read it. A retry with no mark plans and produces, so it has a Producer invocation and is judged as a fresh job.

rejected.option: Read the resume mark from the state directory
rejected.why: It is spent by the time the watcher runs.

rejected.option: Add a 'resumed from' field to the job record in run/mod.rs
rejected.why: Changes what is recorded; out of scope and outside the two-file diff of criterion 6.

decisions.choice: Remaining-stage forecast: constants `PRODUCER_SHARE` 0.7 and `VERIFIER_SHARE` 0.3 of the reading's cost p90, documented as estimates. A resumed retry (candidate built) has only the verifier left, so its forecast is p90 x `VERIFIER_SHARE`.
decisions.reason: The reading's `cost_usd` forecast covers producer and verifier cost. Checks cost no agent dollars and planning is outside the forecast. The stage where the retry resumed does not change the dollars left, so the guard does not parse 'before the verifier' from reason text.

rejected.option: Per-stage shares for planning, build, checks and verify, with the resume stage parsed from the reason
rejected.why: Adds prose parsing and constants for stages that carry no forecast cost.

decisions.choice: T3 drops the spend of an environment-stopped attempt whose work is kept (last on the line, or followed by a resumed attempt) and counts it if the next attempt did not resume it. T1, T2 and T5 never count environment attempts.
decisions.reason: Kept work is not waste. A non-resuming retry redoes the stages, so the earlier spend was wasted and stays visible to T3.

rejected.why: A line that keeps hitting the environment and redoing work would never reach T3.
This is the bug: a complete attempt's spend was read as waste.

decisions.reason: `go` already calls `watch_line` for every finished job, including an environment-stopped `failed` one. The fix is in classification, which lives in scope_guard.rs. Criterion 6 limits the diff to scope_guard.rs and CHANGELOG.md, though the deliverable list names run/mod.rs.

rejected.option: Touch run/mod.rs to skip `watch_line` for environment stops
rejected.why: Would hide the stop from the watcher instead of fixing how it is counted, and would break criterion 6.

decisions.choice: For the regression criteria 3 and 4, name the specific failure each check catches (see demonstrations): a Rejected verdict swallowed by the new Environment path fails the existing T4 tests; an unformatted edit or a clippy warning from the new variant, field or constants fails the fmt and clippy commands.
decisions.reason: Review finding: these two demonstrations lacked fails_without. Each now states what fails if the behavior were missing.

rejected.option: Leave criteria 3 and 4 as bare suite runs
rejected.why: Rejected by review: a behavior criterion must say what fails without the behavior.

files.purpose: Add `Verdict::Environment`, `AttemptRecord.resumed`, `ENVIRONMENT_PREFIX`, `PRODUCER_SHARE`/`VERIFIER_SHARE` (estimates) and `t3_basis`. Make t1/t2/t3/t5 ignore environment attempts. Classify in `attempt_of` and compute `resumed` in `request_records`. Make `try_watch_line` use the counted attempts and the T3 basis. Add the unit tests and the `rig_with_space` helper.
Record the scope guard change under Unreleased.

steps: In scope_guard.rs add `ENVIRONMENT_PREFIX = "environment:"` (doc: the prefix of `disk::LOW_DISK`, which `disk::is_environment_reason` checks; a stop with this prefix is the environment, not the work). Add `PRODUCER_SHARE` 0.7 and `VERIFIER_SHARE` 0.3 (doc: estimates; share of the reading's `cost_usd` forecast, which covers producer and verifier cost; checks cost no agent dollars).

Add `Verdict::Environment` and `AttemptRecord.resumed: bool`, each with a doc comment. Add `fn counted(attempts)` (non-Environment) and pub `t3_basis(attempts, p90) -> (spend, forecast)`: spend drops Environment attempts that are last or followed by a `resumed` attempt; forecast is p90 x `VERIFIER_SHARE` when the last attempt is `resumed` and not Environment, else p90.

Make `t1_retries` use the counted length, `t2_plan_growth` use the counted attempts' plan sizes and rounds, `t5_wall_time` sum the counted minutes, and `t3_cost` use `t3_basis`. `t4_match` and `done` stay as they are. Update those doc comments.

In `attempt_of(job, resumed)`: map `Closed(Failed)` whose reason starts with `ENVIRONMENT_PREFIX` to `Verdict::Environment`; keep other `Closed(_)` as `Failed`. In `request_records`, compute `resumed` from the retry target: `crate::disk::resumable_stop` true for the target's state and reason, and the job has no `Role::Producer` invocation (and `job.job.is_some()`).

In `try_watch_line`, build `MarkNumbers` from the counted attempts (`attempts`, `rejections`, `agent_minutes`) and from `t3_basis` (`spend_usd`, `forecast_p90_usd`); use the same in `facts` so the mark shows what the signals used.

Add tests in `mod tests`: the environment-versus-rejection test, the resumed-retry test with its non-resuming control and an over-budget case, a `LOW_DISK.starts_with(ENVIRONMENT_PREFIX)` check, and set `resumed: false` in `att`. In `watcher_tests` add `rig_with_space` (with `rig` calling it with `plenty_of_space`) and the low-disk end-to-end test using `low_once_verifying`; drop that test if the rig cannot reproduce the stop.
Add the CHANGELOG.md bullet under `## [Unreleased]` in the file's style, naming the scope guard, the two changes and job 20261028-034820-v3rf as the case.
Run `cargo fmt --all`, then `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --locked`. Fix any warning. Confirm only the two listed files changed.

risks.risk: A retry wrongly classed as resumed gets a smaller budget and could pause or flag a line that is a real overrun.
risks.mitigation: `resumed` requires a resumable retry target (`resumable_stop`) and no Producer invocation. A retry that planned and produced is judged as a fresh job. The non-resuming control test pins this.

risks.risk: A line with an earlier rejection, then an environment stop, then a resume is judged on the scaled forecast but also counts the rejection's spend, so it may pause earlier than ideal.
risks.mitigation: The forecast is scaled only when the last counted attempt resumed. The residual case is stated in the `t3_basis` doc comment.

risks.risk: The 0.7/0.3 producer/verifier split is an estimate and may be off.
risks.mitigation: Both shares are named constants with 'estimate' doc comments. Only the verifier share matters, and the test asserts behavior at the boundary, not the exact value.

risks.risk: The end-to-end low-disk test depends on `low_once_verifying` and the rig producing a stop at the verifier gate.
risks.mitigation: The pure tests are the acceptance proof. If the rig does not reproduce the stop, drop the end-to-end test and cover `attempt_of` with a `JobRecords` fixture.

risks.risk: Adding a field and a variant breaks other constructors or matches.
risks.mitigation: `AttemptRecord` is only built in scope_guard.rs (`attempt_of` and the test helper `att`). Update both and run `cargo test` and `cargo clippy --all-targets`.

demonstrations.method: Unit test `environment_stop_is_not_counted_but_a_rejection_is` in `mod tests` of scope_guard.rs. Entry point: the public `evaluate_before_attempt`; no seam or fake is needed. Line A is two `att(Verdict::Environment, ...)` attempts with enough minutes, plan growth and rounds that raw counting would trip T1, T2 and T5. Line B swaps in `rej(...)` with the same costs and minutes. A second test, `a_low_disk_job_is_read_as_an_environment_attempt`, runs in `watcher_tests` through production `Athena::ask` and `go` with a new `rig_with_space` helper (added in step 6; today `rig` hard-codes `plenty_of_space`) that passes the `FreeSpace` fn to `StateDir::with_free_space`, and with the existing reader `crate::test_support::low_once_verifying`. It checks `request_records` yields `Verdict::Environment` and no `pause` or `flag` file exists. If the rig cannot reproduce the stop, drop that test and cover `attempt_of` with a `JobRecords` fixture.
demonstrations.observes: Line A: t1, t2 and t5 are `Level::None`, and `evaluate_before_attempt` gives no pause or flag from them. Line B: the matching signals fire (T1 flags, T2 and T5 pause, T4 pauses on a repeated criterion). The end-to-end job closes `failed` with a reason starting `environment: low disk` and writes no pause or flag file.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the Environment classification and the filter in t1/t2/t5, line A reaches the same levels as line B and the first assertion (no pause) fails. Without T4 counting Rejected, the rejected control would not pause.

demonstrations.method: Unit test `resumed_retry_is_judged_on_remaining_stages` in `mod tests`. Entry points: public `t3_cost`, `t3_basis` and `evaluate_before_attempt`; no seam. Attempts: an Environment attempt (cost 1.4) then an attempt with `resumed: true` (cost 0.1) against p90 1.0, so spend counted is 0.1 against forecast 1.0 x `VERIFIER_SHARE`. A second case where the resumed attempt costs more than 1.5 x p90 x the share must pause, so T3 stays active. Control: the same costs with `resumed: false` give spend 1.5 against p90 1.0 and pause. A `request_records` case with fixture `JobRecords` built in the test (retry target environment-failed, no Producer invocation) checks `resumed` is true; the same with a Producer invocation gives false.
demonstrations.observes: Resumed: `Level::None`. Resumed with spend over the remaining-stage budget: `Level::Pause`. Control with `resumed: false`: `Level::Pause`. `resumed` true only for a resumable target with no Producer invocation.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without `resumed` and the T3 basis, the resumed line's total spend 1.5 reaches 1.5 x p90 and pauses, so the first assertion fails. Without the check that the next attempt resumed, the non-resuming control would not pause either.

demonstrations.method: Run the whole suite. Entry points are the existing production paths those tests already call: `Athena::ask` and `go` with `watch_line` in `watcher_tests` (`t4_pause_via_go_and_ask`, `retry_refuses_paused_line`, `t3_pause_from_reading_forecast`) and the `mod tests` cases on `evaluate_before_attempt`. Their fixtures and rig are unchanged; only the `att` helper gains `resumed: false`, so they act as an unchanged regression oracle for the new rule. These existing tests contain Rejected and plain Failed attempts and no environment reason.
demonstrations.observes: All tests pass: a Rejected verification on the same criterion still pauses on T4, a paused line still refuses a retry, and a cost overrun made of non-environment attempts still pauses on T3 against the full p90.
demonstrations.fails_without: If the new rule were too broad (for example Environment matched any `failed` job or Rejected were filtered like Environment, or the resumed scaling applied to every retry), `t4_pause_via_go_and_ask`, `retry_refuses_paused_line` or `t3_pause_from_reading_forecast` would no longer pause and fail their assertions. If the new variant or field broke a match or constructor, the suite would fail to compile.

demonstrations.method: Run the two checks Athena runs, as two whole commands: `cargo fmt --all --check`, then `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings`. They operate on the final tree, including the new variant, field, constants, `t3_basis` and the new tests. Nothing is injected.
demonstrations.observes: Both exit 0 with no diff output and no warnings.
demonstrations.fails_without: An unformatted edit makes `cargo fmt --all --check` exit non-zero with a diff. A clippy finding in the new code (an unused constant such as `PRODUCER_SHARE` that nothing reads, a match not covering `Verdict::Environment`, needless borrows in `counted`, or an unused helper) makes clippy with -D warnings exit non-zero. So the check fails if the change is left unformatted or leaves dead code.

demonstrations.method: Read the diff: one bullet under `## [Unreleased]` in the file's existing style. It names the scope guard, states that attempts ended by the environment (low disk, interruption) do not count toward the attempt, round and time signals, states that a retry resuming a kept candidate is forecast on its remaining stages, and names job 20261028-034820-v3rf as the case.
demonstrations.observes: The entry exists under Unreleased and names both changes.

demonstrations.method: Check the stat lists only the two files, then read `git diff crates/athena-core/src/scope_guard.rs`. Every new item (`PRODUCER_SHARE`, `VERIFIER_SHARE`, `ENVIRONMENT_PREFIX`, `Verdict::Environment`, `resumed`, `t3_basis`) has a doc comment stating its basis (`disk::LOW_DISK`, `resumable_stop`, the `cost_usd` forecast) or marking it an estimate. A unit test asserts `crate::disk::LOW_DISK.starts_with(ENVIRONMENT_PREFIX)`, tying the prefix to its source.
demonstrations.observes: Only crates/athena-core/src/scope_guard.rs and CHANGELOG.md are listed, and every new item carries a doc comment.

open_questions: The brief lists crates/athena-core/src/run/mod.rs as an expected deliverable but criterion 6 limits the diff to scope_guard.rs and CHANGELOG.md. This plan does not touch run/mod.rs because the `watch_line` call there already runs for every finished job. Confirm that is intended.

No code records a usage-limit stop: the only environment reason written is `disk::LOW_DISK`. The guard matches the prefix `environment:`, so a usage-limit stop is excluded once it is recorded with that prefix. Recording it is outside this change.

An interrupted job is `Dispatched` with no outcome and `attempt_of` already returns `None` for it, so it is not counted today. If an operator closes it with `athena close`, it reads as a plain failure; the guard cannot tell without new records.
The default `min_free_gb` (athena-data config.rs `DEFAULT_MIN_FREE_GB`) was not read. The end-to-end test assumes `low_once_verifying`'s 3 GB is below it, as the run/mod.rs resume tests do.
